description: Raspberry Pi fleet: health, thermals, power, resources, storage, network and time sync for every Pi.

panels.title: Fleet health
panels.description: Worst state per Pi across these checks. DOWN: rpi_exporter or node_exporter not scraped. ALERT: SoC >= 80 °C, under-voltage now, root FS >= 90 % or read-only, < 10 % memory available. WARN: SoC >= 70 °C, blade firmware throttling, root FS >= 80 %, < 20 % memory available, Pi 5 fan commanded on but tach reads 0 RPM, clock not NTP-synchronised. Details in the table below.

targets.expr:
max by (host) (
  label_replace((1 - min by (host) (label_replace(up{job=~"rpi_exporter|integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):(9243|9100)"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))) * 3, "check", "down", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace((rpi_cpu_temperature_celsius{job="rpi_exporter", instance=~"($host):9243"} >= bool 70) + (rpi_cpu_temperature_celsius{job="rpi_exporter", instance=~"($host):9243"} >= bool 80), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "temp", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(node_hwmon_in_lcrit_alarm_volts{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2, "check", "undervolt", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_throttle_active{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666", flag!="under_voltage"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "bladethrottle", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_throttle_active{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666", flag="under_voltage"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2, "check", "bladeundervolt", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} >= bool 0.8) + (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} >= bool 0.9), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "rootfs", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(node_filesystem_readonly{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2, "check", "readonly", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"} < bool 0.2) + (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"} < bool 0.1), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "memory", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace((node_hwmon_pwm{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", chip="platform_cooling_fan"} > bool 0) * on (instance) group_left () (node_hwmon_fan_rpm{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", chip="platform_cooling_fan"} == bool 0), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "fanstall", "", "")
  or label_replace(1 - min by (host) (label_replace(node_timex_sync_status{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "timesync", "", "")
)

panels.title: Hosts down
panels.description: Pis whose rpi_exporter or node_exporter target is not up.

panels.title: Hottest SoC
panels.description: Highest SoC temperature right now (rpi_exporter). Pi 5 soft-throttles at 80 °C, Pi 4 / CM4 at 80 °C too (85 °C hard).

panels.title: Hottest NVMe
panels.description: Highest NVMe composite temperature (node_exporter hwmon, sensor temp1).

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (host) (label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", chip="nvme_nvme0", sensor="temp1"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

panels.title: Power events
panels.description: Pis that reported under-voltage (firmware hwmon alarm) at any point in the selected time range, or blades whose firmware reports any throttle flag since boot.

targets.expr: count((max by (host) (label_replace(max_over_time(node_hwmon_in_lcrit_alarm_volts{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}[$__range]), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) > 0) or (max by (host) (label_replace(max_over_time(computeblade_throttle_occurred{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666"}[$__range]), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fullest root FS
panels.description: Highest root filesystem usage.

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (host) (label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

panels.title: Least memory free
panels.description: Lowest MemAvailable as share of MemTotal.

panels.title: Latest reboot
panels.description: Shortest uptime in the fleet.

panels.title: Worst clock offset
panels.description: Largest absolute kernel clock offset (node_timex_offset_seconds).

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: One row per Pi. Fan RPM is empty for the Pi 4 PoE-HAT workers (their fan has no tachometer). Fan duty: Pi 5 / PoE HAT PWM, or the blade fan unit's target. Power: firmware under-voltage alarm (all Pis) and firmware throttle flags (blades only).

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(rpi_fan_rpm{job="rpi_exporter", instance=~"($host):9243"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) or max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_fan_speed{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666"} < 20000, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

max by (host) (label_replace(node_hwmon_pwm{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", chip=~"platform_cooling_fan|platform_pwm_fan"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / 255 * 100 or max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_fan_target_percent{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

max by (host) (label_replace(node_load5{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / count by (host) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mode="idle"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

100 * (1 - max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

max by (host) (label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

max by (host, medium) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"), "medium", "SD / eMMC", "device", "/dev/mmcblk.*"), "medium", "NVMe", "device", "/dev/nvme.*"))

max by (host) (label_replace(node_hwmon_in_lcrit_alarm_volts{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2 or max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_throttle_active{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: SoC temperature heat strip
panels.description: SoC temperature per Pi over time (rpi_exporter), averaged per cell. Blues are the normal operating range; yellow from 70 °C, orange from 75 °C, red at 80 °C where the firmware starts throttling.

panels.title: SoC temperature
panels.description: rpi_exporter CPU (SoC) temperature, smoothed over the rate interval (>= 4 min).

panels.title: NVMe temperature
panels.description: NVMe composite temperature (hwmon nvme temp1). timepi's NVMe is idle; it boots from SD.

panels.title: Fan speed
panels.description: Tachometer reading averaged per cell: Pi 5 active cooler (rpi_exporter) and blade fan unit (compute-blade-agent; readings above 20k RPM are sensor glitches and dropped). Grey = stopped. The Pi 4 PoE-HAT fans on the k3s workers have no tachometer. A Pi with duty on the right but grey here has a stalled or unplugged fan.

panels.title: Fan duty
panels.description: Commanded fan duty, averaged per cell: hwmon PWM (0-255 as %) for Pi 5 coolers and Pi 4 PoE HATs, target percent for the blade fan units. Grey = fan off.

panels.title: Power & throttle state
panels.description: Under-voltage alarm from the firmware hwmon (rpi_volt, all Pis) and firmware throttle flags (arm_freq_capped, soft_temp_limit, throttled) reported by the blades' compute-blade-agent.

targets.expr:
max by (host) (
  label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(node_hwmon_in_lcrit_alarm_volts{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2, "check", "uv", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_throttle_active{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666", flag!="under_voltage"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")), "check", "bt", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (host) (label_replace(computeblade_throttle_active{job="blade_exporter", instance=~"($host):9666", flag="under_voltage"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) * 2, "check", "bu", "", "")
)

panels.title: CPU clock, % of max
panels.description: Average cpufreq clock as a share of the core's maximum (Pi 5 2.4 GHz, Pi 4 1.8 GHz, CM4 1.5 GHz). Low is normal when idle (ondemand governor); low while busy points to throttling.

targets.expr: 100 * avg by (host) (label_replace(avg_over_time(node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}[$__interval]), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / max by (host) (label_replace(node_cpu_scaling_frequency_max_hertz{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: Share of non-idle CPU time across all cores.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: 5-minute load average divided by core count; above 1 means runnable work is queueing.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(node_load5{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / count by (host) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mode="idle"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

panels.title: Swap used
panels.description: Swap in use as share of swap size. The 2 GB Pi 4 workers lean on swap first.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")) / max by (host) (label_replace(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100"} > 0, "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

panels.title: Root filesystem used
panels.description: Root filesystem usage per Pi.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (host) (label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", instance=~"($host):9100", mountpoint="/"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")))

panels.title: SD / eMMC writes in range
panels.description: Bytes written to the SD card or eMMC (mmcblk0) during the selected time range: the main SD wear driver. Hosts at 0 have a card or eMMC present but run from NVMe.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time the boot disk (mmcblk0 / nvme0n1) had I/O in flight.

panels.title: Disk writes
panels.description: Bytes written per second, SD/eMMC + NVMe combined.

panels.title: Disk reads
panels.description: Bytes read per second, SD/eMMC + NVMe combined.

panels.title: I/O wait
panels.description: Share of CPU time waiting on block I/O; on SD-card hosts this is the first sign of a slow or dying card.

panels.title: eth0 receive
panels.description: eth0 receive rate. All Pis link at 1 Gbit/s.

panels.title: eth0 transmit
panels.description: eth0 transmit rate.

panels.title: TCP retransmits
panels.description: Retransmitted TCP segments as share of segments sent.

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: Kernel clock offset from the NTP/PTP discipline (node_timex_offset_seconds). timepi is the GPS/PTP reference.

panels.title: Oscillator drift
panels.description: Frequency correction the kernel applies to each Pi's crystal, in parts per million ((node_timex_frequency_adjustment_ratio - 1) x 1e6). Steady values are normal; jumps follow temperature swings.

panels.title: Clock synchronised
panels.description: Kernel reports the clock as synchronised (node_timex_sync_status).

title: Raspberry Pi Fleet
